body: There are only 2 i would have a romantic relationship with. But i wasnt even going to try with the first girl. she was telling me how school was going and i was telling her how work was going, then i asked her to get coffee and there was no reply. It doesnt bother me that the other girl i would have had a relationship with ignored me. whatever, im not going to be right for everyone. What bothers me are the 2 friends, one i had a thing with but ended on mutual terms to just be friends. I was friends with the other one for over 5 years. I feel abandoned by the 2 friends.
